transport.requestHandling: JSDOM request interceptor and injected fetch; no TCP listener
transport.socketHandling: synthetic in-memory socket shim; no audio capture, speech service, or STT backend

coverage.malformedPayloads: bounded malformed/null payloads leave the ticker empty
coverage.localeRace: late translation/socket results after pagehide do not mutate closed renderer
coverage.negative: unknown HTTP routes, including /api/i18n/locales, unsupported socket events and provider paths return fixture 404
coverage.localeDiscoveryDenial: The actual /api/i18n/locales fetch is attempted and rejected by the existing interceptor as unknown-route; the fixture allowlist is unchanged.
coverage.cleanup: The bounded 100 ms shared-i18n retry binds the renderer's existing socket after script-order delay. BFCache pagehide preserves it; final pagehide removes only the renderer-owned global reference, shared i18n listeners, renderer listeners and observers, then disconnects the local socket.
